review.rationale: Option A is technically and governance-sound. It correctly identifies that the root cause is a missing caller-supplied SOURCE_REVISION input rather than a source capability gap, leverages the existing exact-source contract (process.env.SOURCE_REVISION) without modifying code, preserves the prior v0.1 failure as immutable non-qualifying evidence, enforces one-attempt caps across fetch/worktree/ci/release/test/archive, requires manifest self-description parity (release.json and release-manifest.json both equal to the exact full SHA), and explicitly forbids deployment, release, server interaction, retries, fallbacks, and history overwrite. The fresh review transport is cleanly separated from the prior failed session, and all authority boundaries remain intact.
